name: io.github.Servosity/appdirect-mcp
title: AppDirect MCP
description: AppDirect marketplace operations with an offline mirror and cross-company billing reconciliation.

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the AppDirect API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Set the APPDIRECT_CLIENT_ID credential for the AppDirect MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Set the APPDIRECT_CLIENT_SECRET credential for the AppDirect MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the OAuth2 scope sent to AppDirect (default: ROLE_PARTNER ROLE_PARTNER_READ).

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave the prefilled default unless your tenant uses a different token endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: APPDIRECT_NO_CONFIG_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to config.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.
